scope: Deliverable A: eight patron portraits only
reference_authority: Approved title-screen Celestial and Heavenprint pilot; gouache/broken-ink portrait anchors
user_overrides: Public divine apparitions; hidden origins must not inform visible mortal casting.
Each patron has its own dominant accent; this supersedes shared gold and overlapping brief colours.
export_method: Pillow Lanczos resize to 800x1000 RGB PNG; no painted content altered during export. Native generator dimensions retained below.
palette_note: Hex values are design anchors, not exact indexed pixel colours. Ivory, charcoal and tonal variations remain.

portraits.name: Holy Father Nerukhan
portraits.description: Ivory judge-effigy, raised hand and nine small halo lights above a tribunal.
portraits.generation_prompt:
Create one original Project Heaven Cry divine patron apparition, vertical 4:5 full bleed for 800x1000 PNG. HEAVENPRINT GOD DEPICTION. The first two references are the PRIMARY divinity authority: immense luminous Celestial and pilot's giant ivory sacred figure. Third reference is for opaque angular gouache and broken ink only; do not borrow its human character appearance. Public art must keep hidden narrator lore hidden. Show an awe-inspiring deity, with impossible sacred presence, not an ordinary human wearing a costume. No skin pores, natural skin colour, wrinkles, actor's face or mortal identity. Faces may be idealized ivory effigies, masks or radiant absence as specified for this patron. Humanoid presence stays readable and graceful. Do not render all patrons as the same armored light giant.
Divinity through focused radiance, deliberate answering emblem/halo, deep sacred negative space, impossibly large scale and edges dispersing into square light motes. Full portrait: head/torso/decisive gesture fill most of frame, tiny far-off architecture along lowest edge supplies scale, not a full city panorama. Paint with broad opaque directional gouache, dry bristle, selective dark broken ink, warm ivory and deep charcoal, precise expressive silhouettes, no glossy 3D or photographic bloom. Clear forms, no cubist puzzle. Retain each patron's distinct accent; don't wash all eight in gold. Use a coherent primary light physically touching mantle, hands and objects. Original archetypes only: no recognisable real god or saint, real religious emblems, existing franchise designs. No text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, UI, captions or borders. Hands/props must be anatomically intelligible; avoid extra limbs or fingers. Quiet dark space around head and meaningful gesture.

The absolute patriarch of the fictional Lumeri saint-church, colossal front-facing rigid upright silhouette, head centered high, broad descending heavy vestments. His face is a stern smooth ALABASTER EFFIGY, simplified severe brow and closed mouth, two deep narrow gold-lit eye recesses, no skin, beard or individual human age; small sculpted planes rather than realistic features. Gaze seems already decided, no smile. Huge dark charcoal mantle over layered ivory robes, decorated with large pale-gold embroidered open-hand motifs, no crosses, no mitre or real clerical costume. A unique tall oval standing collar frames his head. His right hand rises toward viewer, palm forward in a full five-finger judgement gesture that dominates one side; left hand closes calmly across chest. Pale-gold answering emblem: an open ring of nine small detached oval lights surrounding a central empty dark circle behind the head, each like a hovering witness, rather than ornate church window. Lower vestments dissolve into vertical gold motes over a tiny industrial stone tribunal at bottom. Divine severity and a vast silence. Use deliberately simple massive robe planes, not jagged armor.

portraits.generation_prompt:

PRIMARY AUTHORITY: reference 1's enormous otherworldly faceless luminous Celestial, angular ivory/gold volumes, drifting square motes, overwhelming scale and strong charcoal negative space; reference 2's giant simplified ivory sacred figure and weathered print-paint grammar. Reference 3 is ONLY an ink/gouache brushwork anchor, not human anatomy or casting. Do not use the earlier human officer image. Do not depict or suggest hidden human origins, theatrical acting or cosplay.

Composition: dramatic low view of an immense upright three-quarter deity, broad rigid rectangular shoulders, visible head and torso dominating the portrait, monumental silhouette against an almost-black olive-charcoal supply citadel. Bottom 12% contains tiny distant ammunition-crate towers, a few minute human silhouettes and cranes ONLY as scale cues. This being dwarfs them. Face is a smooth searing warm-IVORY absence recessed under a severe floating BRASS brow/visor and high collar, NO skin, hair, wrinkles, eyes, nose, human smile or photographic face. Not a robot/mech: entirely supernatural, made of condensed light and immense layered ceremonial matter.

Read unmistakably as an officer-god of supply and requisition: an enormous GREATCOAT of structured charcoal/olive planes with lapels that become long ivory radiant folded plates; blank floating ration tags are narrow gilt talismans orbiting chest. Long rows of gold supply-seal impressions with no symbols/text descend the mantle. One massive hand of ivory light holds a CLOSED rectangular ledger against ribs; the other firmly lowers a monumental stamp-shaped SEAL (short thick stem, broad squared base) whose pale olive-brass light answers above ranks of glowing ammunition crates below. Two arms, coherent and stately. The seal should be iconic and clear even at thumbnail size. A broad double rectangular aureole frames head and shoulders with a deliberate empty charcoal gap, like a cosmic order that cannot be appealed. Separate staggered hanging light strips and square motes disintegrate the lower greatcoat into radiant order. Reserve brightest white gold to head, seal edge and one halo corner.

Emotional quality through pose and silhouette: immutable, patient, implacable martial providence; all materiel is counted. No comic mundane office scene. Palette olive brass answering light, warm ivory, aged gold, muted olive-black, no neon colours. Sharp designed luminous edges rather than glow haze. Opaque angular gouache, strong broken ink contours, visible dry directional strokes and restrained printed speckle like Heavenprint. Sacred negative space and scale do the work, avoid dense random filigree or shiny generic game-god render. No real religious symbols, real-world military emblems, letters, numbers, readable marks, brand names, cross or crescent. No face portrait, no flesh. Original solemn divine icon with tangible impossible robes.
